{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Fleurrh City |characters=フレイシティ |japanese=Frey City |image=Fleurrh City.png |imagesize=250px |region=Kalos |colorscheme=XYZ |epicode=XY109 |episode=Master Class Choices! }} '''Fleurrh City''' (Japanese: '''フレイシティ''' ''Frey City'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]], located between [[Couriway Town]] and [[Snowbelle City]]. Like many other {{cat|cities}} in the [[region]], it is home to a [[Pokémon Showcase]] theater. It is the [[hometown]] of {{OBP|Amelia|XY109}}. It was first mentioned by [[Monsieur Pierre]] in ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', when he told the attendees at his dance party that the city would host an upcoming Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class. The competition took place in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'' where {{an|Serena}}, Amelia, and many other [[Pokémon Performer]]s entered the event hoping to win the Fleurrh City {{DL|Pokémon Showcase|Princess Key}}. During the Theme Performance, in which contestants had to place the highest number of {{p|Rhyhorn}} on their part of the field before time ran out, Serena was grouped with [[Kazalie]] and [[Concetta]]. She put her racing skills to good use and gathered a large group of Rhyhorn, defeating her opponents. Amelia and [[Shulin]] also managed to advance to the second round. However, [[Alouette]], [[Clarice]], and [[Sara Lee]] ended up being eliminated. In the Freestyle Performance, Amelia dazzled the crowd together with her {{shiny}} {{p|Dragonair}} and {{p|Espeon}}. Serena also impressed the audience with her {{TP|Serena|Braixen}}, {{TP|Serena|Pancham}}, and {{TP|Serena|Sylveon}}. In the end, their score could not be closer, but as Serena had received just a few more points, she was declared the winner, thus earning her third and final Princess Key and qualifying for the Master Class. ==Gallery== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background:#{{green color light}}; border:3px solid #{{grass color}}" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Pokémon Center}} ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | Showcase theater |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Fleurrh City Pokémon Center.png|x160px]] | [[File:Fleurrh Showcase theater.png|x160px]] |} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{fairy color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{fairy color dark}}" |- !
